protocol.title: Ultrasensitive Digital Quantification of Cytokines and Bacteria Predicts Septic Shock Outcomes
protocol.platform: Digital proximity ligation assay (dPLA) + droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) on Bio-Rad QX200
protocol.objective: Simultaneous femtomolar-sensitivity quantification of cytokine proteins (IL-6, TNF-alpha) and bacterial DNA biomarkers (GN 16S rRNA, GP 16S rRNA, blaTEM antibiotic-resistance gene) from human BALF and plasma; applied to asthma cohort and ICU septic shock cohort with decision-tree outcome prediction (>90% accuracy)

instrument.tubes: 0.2 uL thin-walled PCR tubes (Thermo Fisher #AB-0620); 0.2 uL thin-walled PCR strips (Thermo Fisher #AB-1182)

antibodies.IL6_biotinylated: Biotinylated anti-human IL-6 polyclonal goat antibody (R&D Systems #BAF206)
antibodies.TNFa_biotinylated: Biotinylated anti-human TNF-alpha polyclonal goat antibody (R&D Systems #BAF210)

reagents.proximity_probe_kit: TaqMan Protein Assays Open Kit (Thermo Fisher #4453745)

sample_dilution_buffers.HMB: Homemade Nong's buffer: 1x PBS, 1 mM d-biotin (Sigma #47868), 0.1% gelatin (Aurion #900.03), 0.05% Tween-20 (Sigma #P9416), 100 nM goat IgG (Thermo Fisher #50643345), 0.1 mg/mL salmon sperm DNA (Invitrogen #15632-011), 4 mM EDTA (Invitrogen #AM9261) — TNF-alpha in plasma
sample_dilution_buffers.TM_buffer: Biochain TM buffer (K3011010-1) diluted 0.1x in Milli-Q water + 0.5% gelatin — IL-6 and TNF-alpha in BALF

reagents.blaTEM_standard: pBR322 TEM-1 plasmid in competent E. coli (NEB #C2987H); plasmid isolated by QIAprep Miniprep (Qiagen #27104)
reagents.gblock_fragments: GN 16S rRNA, GP 16S rRNA, blaTEM gBlock fragments (IDT); diluted in AVE buffer + 0.1 mg/mL salmon sperm DNA

universal_bacteria.Bac_fwd: Forward primer targeting 16S rRNA conserved region (GN and GP)
universal_bacteria.Bac_rev: Reverse primer targeting 16S rRNA conserved region (GN and GP)

primers_probes.GN_probe: HEX-labeled hydrolysis probe — GN-specific 16S rRNA region
primers_probes.GP_probe: FAM-labeled hydrolysis probe — GP-specific 16S rRNA region
primers_probes.blaTEM_probe: FAM-labeled hydrolysis probe — blaTEM beta-lactamase gene

IL6.sample_dilution: 5-fold in SDB-II (plasma) or 0.1x TM buffer + 0.5% gelatin (BALF)
IL6.ligation_reagent: 20x ligation reaction buffer + nuclease-free water + DNA ligase (1x in ligase dilution buffer)
IL6.ddPCR_reaction_composition: 9 uL PLA eluate + 10 uL 2x ddPCR Supermix + 1 uL 20x Universal PCR Assay

TNFa.sample_dilution: 5-fold in HMB (plasma) or 0.1x TM buffer + 0.5% gelatin (BALF)
TNFa.incubation_duration: Overnight (~12 h; modelled as 720 min in BioScript)
TNFa.ligation_stop: Protease digestion: 2 uL 1x protease in PBS -> 37 C 10 min -> 95 C 15 min
TNFa.note_buffer: SDB-II incompatible with TNF-alpha; HMB required due to rapid TNF-alpha degradation

triplex_assay_LODs.note: Triplex (IL-6 + GN + GP) from same BALF sample in same ddPCR reaction using two fluorescent probes and differential intensity levels

protocol: 100 uL sample + 100 uL PBS + 20 uL proteinase K
Add 100 uL buffer VXL; incubate RT 15 min
Add 350 uL buffer ACB; mix thoroughly
Load lysate to QIAamp Mini column; centrifuge 6000 g, 1 min
Wash with AW1 buffer; centrifuge 6000 g, 1 min
Wash with AW2 buffer; centrifuge 6000 g, 1 min
Add 100 uL AVE; incubate 1 min; centrifuge 20000 g, 1 min
DNA_extraction.background_correction: PBS blank extraction performed; average background signal subtracted from all human samples

cohort_1_BALF.description: Bronchoalveolar lavage fluid; asthma vs healthy
cohort_1_BALF.asthma_demographics: Average age 46 [38-53]; 53% female; 65% white, 30% black, 4% others
cohort_1_BALF.bronchoscopy: Within 4 weeks of visit; described in White et al. 2017 (IRB approved, University of Chicago)

cohort_2_plasma_ICU.description: Septic shock ICU patients; plasma at multiple time points
cohort_2_plasma_ICU.protocol_IRB: 18-1163 (University of Chicago IRB); Declaration of Helsinki
cohort_2_plasma_ICU.eligibility: Adults >18 years; Medical ICU; vasoactive medication for BP; suspected infection; enrolled within first 24h of diagnosis
cohort_2_plasma_ICU.antibiotic_note: All patients had received antibiotics prior to sample collection (standard of care within 3h of sepsis suspicion)

time_points.t1: Within first 24h of Sepsis-3 shock diagnosis (enrollment)
time_points.t3: Upon resolution of septic shock (Group B only)

cohort_2_plasma_ICU.plasma_processing: Centrifuge 500g 15 min within 2h of collection; store at -80 C
cohort_2_plasma_ICU.clinical_scores: APACHE-II and SOFA calculated on day of enrollment

A.definition: Early recovery: shock resolved within 48h (no vasopressors; MAP >65 mmHg); samples at t1, t2

B.definition: Late recovery: shock resolved after 48h; samples at t1, t2, t3

C.definition: Death: never resolved shock; died in ICU on vasopressors; samples at t1, t2

steps.name: DNA Extraction from human sample
steps.output: extractedDNA (eluted in AVE buffer; stored at -20 C until use)
steps.notes: Background signal from kit blank subtracted offline. Preconcentration of sample during extraction can further improve bacterial LOD.

steps.name: IL-6 dPLA — Proximity probe preparation and incubation
steps.notes: Proximity probes (5' and 3') conjugated to biotinylated anti-IL-6 antibody via streptavidin. Only IL-6-specific signal; cross-reactivity with IL-10 and TNF-alpha 1-2 orders of magnitude lower.

steps.name: IL-6 dPLA — Ligation and stop

key_conditions.ligation_solution_composition: 50 uL 20x ligation buffer + 909 uL nuclease-free water + 1 uL DNA ligase

steps.notes: Ligation joins the 5' and 3' oligonucleotides only when both proximity probes bind the same IL-6 molecule. Ligated product is the ddPCR template.

steps.name: IL-6 dPLA — ddPCR reaction setup and thermal cycling
TNF-alpha dPLA — Proximity probe incubation

key_conditions.incubation_note: Overnight incubation at 4 C to maximise TNF-alpha signal (720 min = conservative ~12h lower bound)

steps.notes: SDB-II incompatible with TNF-alpha (TNF-alpha degrades rapidly; sensitive to storage conditions). HMB based on Nong's buffer (Nat. Protoc. 8, 1234, 2013).

steps.name: TNF-alpha dPLA — Ligation and protease stop
steps.operation: mix + heat (protease digestion stop, not heat stop)
steps.notes: Protease digestion replaces heat stop for TNF-alpha to avoid non-specific signal from incomplete antibody denaturation.

steps.name: TNF-alpha dPLA — ddPCR reaction setup and thermal cycling
Triplex ddPCR — GN bacteria + GP bacteria + blaTEM

key_conditions.cluster_readout: 2D amplitude plot: HEX+ (GN), FAM-medium (GP), FAM-high (blaTEM), empty droplets; fluorescence amplitude thresholds set manually/automatically

steps.notes: Detects both pathogenic bacteria and endogenous microbiota. Duplex assay (GN + GP only) also validated and shown to agree with triplex (Supplementary Fig. 6). blaTEM resolves 1-copy-number difference per uL; result available within 2h vs days for blood culture.

steps.name: Decision-tree classification of patient outcome
inputs: ddpcrSignal (GN CPN/uL, TNF-alpha pg/mL at t1)

decision_thresholds.interpretation: GN < 85 CPN/uL at t1 -> Group C (death) with 100% accuracy

steps.notes: Counterintuitive finding: lower GN at t1 correlates with death (excessive cytokine response, not bacterial burden, drives mortality). IL-6 temporal change (t1->t2), not absolute level, is the strongest individual mortality predictor: 89% of patients with increasing IL-6 were Group C; 85% with decreasing IL-6 were Group A or B.

BALF_asthma.GN_elevation: Almost all asthma patients had high GN levels vs 55% of healthy individuals
BALF_asthma.IL6_elevation: IL-6 levels significantly higher in asthma patients than healthy (p<0.01)
BALF_asthma.TNFa: Uniformly low in all BALF samples (<0.5 pg/mL, near LOD)

GN_dynamics.Group_A: GN decreased rapidly t1->t2 (average -157 CPN/uL); early recovery
GN_dynamics.Group_B: GN increased quickly t1->t2 (average +108 CPN/uL); late recovery
GN_dynamics.Group_C: GN decreased slightly by t2; counterintuitively associated with death

GP_dynamics.Group_A_C: GP decreased to nondetectable at t2
GP_dynamics.Group_B: GP remained at moderate level (13-36 CPN/uL) across all 3 time points

plasma_septic_shock.IL6_dynamics: Temporal change (not absolute level) correlates with mortality: increase -> death; decrease -> recovery
plasma_septic_shock.blaTEM_detection: One Group B patient showed blaTEM increase from 0 to >300 CPN/uL at t3; confirmed beta-lactam-producing bacteria on blood culture same day — detected on day of collection vs days for culture
plasma_septic_shock.TNFa: Group B had highest TNF-alpha at t1 and t2; dropped to <10 pg/mL at t3 (shock resolution). Group C showed very low TNF-alpha (progressed past initial cytokine peak).

LOD_calculation.method: LOD = background signal + 2x SD of background signal, or intercept of linear regression curve (whichever higher)
LOD_calculation.IL6_resolution_method: Two measurements distinguishable if absolute difference > 2x SD of both measurements; ~0.04 pg/mL in two patients (one Group A, one Group C)

statistical_analysis.BALF_test: Two-part statistical test (zero-inflated) with Benjamini-Hochberg correction (twopart_statistics.R, Supplementary Software 1)
statistical_analysis.septic_shock_test: Two-sided Mann-Whitney U test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction
statistical_analysis.decision_tree: scikit-learn DecisionTreeClassifier (max_depth=2); StratifiedKFold (n_splits=5); compared with LDA and logistic regression (decision tree superior, less prone to overfitting at this sample size)
